title: Temporal Graph Prototype-conditioned Conformal Prediction for Fraud Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.15768v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Conformal prediction (CP) provides distribution-free coverage guarantees and has emerged as a principled tool for uncertainty quantification. In edge-level fraud detection on temporal interaction graphs, where false positives and false negatives both carry substantial cost, such coverage guarantees are particularly appealing for risk-aware decision making. However, directly applying existing graph conformal predictors yields inefficient prediction sets due to two recurring properties of fraud data. Fraudulent interactions are often embedded in benign-dominated neighborhoods that dilute calibration signals, while extreme class imbalance leaves scarce labeled-fraud support in the calibration split and leads to overly conservative class-conditional thresholds. translated_title: 时间图原型条件化共形预测用于欺诈检测
translated_abstract: 共形预测（CP）提供了无分布的覆盖保证，并已成为不确定性量化的原则性工具。在时间交互图上的边级欺诈检测中，假阳性和假阴性都带来巨大成本，因此这种覆盖保证对于风险感知决策尤为有吸引力。然而，直接应用现有的图共形预测器会产生低效的预测集，这是由于欺诈数据的两个常见特性所致。欺诈交互通常嵌入在良性主导的邻域中，这会稀释校准信号，而极端的类别不平衡使得校准分割中标记欺诈支持稀少，导致类别条件阈值过于保守。为解决这些问题，我们提出了ProtoCP，一种用于时间图边级欺诈检测的共形预测框架。ProtoCP通过聚焦于原型节点来改善校准效率。
tldr: 本文提出ProtoCP框架，利用时间图原型条件化共形预测，解决了欺诈检测中邻域信号稀释和类别不平衡导致的预测集低效问题。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ProtoCP, a conformal prediction framework using temporal graph prototypes, to address inefficient prediction sets caused by neighborhood signal dilution and extreme class imbalance in fraud detection.
